responsibility: Supplies IA-64’s common target hooks for optimization presets, early option checking, and unwind-model selection. It installs scheduler and cache-related default parameters used by optimization, validates the restricted set of accepted -mtls-size values, chooses between configured SJLJ, disabled unwind info, or native unwind tables based on exception/unwind flags, and sets the combined default target and CPU flag state consumed by the main IA-64 backend.
